pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102961

This PR includes two fixes:

1. proper validation of `UNSIGNED_LONG` input for all the aggregate functions that do not support it (all of them, apart from `count()`)
2. `VERSION` type is actually supported by a few aggregations (`count()`, `count_distinct()`), but `AggregateMapper` did not handle it properly (now it does). Other agg functions do not support it but they properly validate it as an invalid input (added a test case for it)
pr_title: ES|QL: Improve type validation in aggs for UNSIGNED_LONG better support for VERSION
